description: The chart illustrates the accuracy and token count of four different models, namely CoT, CoD, CCoT, and CoUT, with the categories listed on the horizontal axis. The vertical axes represent accuracy percentage on the left and token count on the right, both with linear scales. The bars are grouped by category, with each group consisting of four bars colored red (CoT), orange (CoD), blue (CCoT), and green (CoUT). The accuracy values are 91.19% for CoT, 80.89% for CoD, 88.50% for CCoT, and 88.40% for CoUT, while the token counts are 676.85 for CoT, 534.24 for CoD, 445.91 for CCoT, and 354.46 for CoUT. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized. The chart provides a clear visual representation of the performance of each model in terms of both accuracy and token count.
